hooks.command: in=$(cat); msg=''; if echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*CLAUDE\.md"'; then msg='CLAUDE.md changed - the copy injected at session start is now stale; re-read the file before relying on project instructions.'; elif echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*(\.claude/settings\.json|plugins/directives-toolkit/(agents|commands|skills|hooks|scripts)/)'; then msg='Hook/agent configuration changed - it loads only at session start; takes effect next session, do not assume it is live.'; fi; if [ -n "$msg" ]; then echo "$msg" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
